description: This file defines Express route handlers for authentication-related endpoints, including a health check for auth configuration and a placeholder login endpoint. It uses Swagger comments for API documentation and references external configuration functions.

methods.name: router.get('/health')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /health, returning the status of tenant salt configuration.

methods.name: router.post('/login')
methods.description: Handles POST requests to /login, validating inputs, checking salt configuration, resolving tenant, and returning a placeholder success or error response.
